shapeSummary: SPDT micro switch: 20 x 10.2 x 6.4 mm black body (X length, Y height, Z thickness) with two 2.4 mm through-holes along Z, three flat 3.2 mm wide solder tabs extending 3.5 mm below the body, a flat lever arm on top, and a cylindrical roller at the lever tip.
warnings: The lever is modeled as a flat plate; the real one is slightly angled and bent.
Roller diameter, width and height are estimated from the image.
Tab X positions are estimated, with the middle tab placed midway between the outer tabs.
Tab holes and the pivot are omitted because they are not clearly visible.
The 10.2 mm height is assumed to be the body only, with the tabs added below it, so total height is greater than 10.2 mm.
The hole height of 2.9 mm above the body bottom is uncertain.
The lever arm length is approximately 16.3 mm, but its pivot position is estimated.
